headline: Free Toll Implemented Between Pulilan and San Fernando; RFID Users to Get Refunds
seoTitle: NLEX Pulilan-San Fernando Free Toll, RFID Refunds | FMB News
seoDescription: The Pulilan-San Fernando NLEX route was placed under a toll waiver during flood-related traffic disruption, with TRB assuring refunds for RFID charges.
keywords: NLEX free toll Pulilan San Fernando
deck: The waiver was introduced as flooding near Tulaoc Bridge in San Simon caused severe traffic disruption along the expressway.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Department of Transportation secured a toll waiver for all vehicle classes traveling between Pulilan, Bulacan, and San Fernando, Pampanga, and vice versa, as flooding near the Tulaoc Bridge disrupted NLEX traffic.

sections.heading: RFID refunds
paragraphs: The Toll Regulatory Board said motorists using RFID could initially see normal charges posted to their accounts, but the toll operator would perform backroom adjustments to return charges covered by the waiver.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: The toll relief reduced the financial burden on motorists already facing unusually long delays caused by flood-related traffic conditions.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Motorists should monitor NLEX and TRB advisories for the duration of the waiver, account adjustments and changes in road conditions around San Simon.
